prompts.room: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background PNG for an original cute Japanese handheld pixel art hamster training game. Input1 is approved layout reference, especially panel 2 cozy wooden hamster room. Input2 existing game painting palette reference. Create ONLY the room background, no UI, no text, no characters. Wide 16:9 full bleed interior cutaway, fixed eye-level slight top-down 2D game perspective, coherent pixel clusters and crisp nearest-neighbor style, GBA-style warm colorful palette. Wooden walls, window with red gingham curtains and green garden outside on upper left, warm hanging lamp, big wooden hamster exercise wheel on back right, little arched wooden sleeping nest at back left, bedding straw scattered along floor edges, small blue water bottle mounted left, sunflower motif bowl and tiny seed jar to side. Furnishings hamster-scale. Large clear straw-gold floor area across center foreground (45% width) for existing animated protagonist; protagonist feet will stand at 78% image height. Do not put foreground furniture or bowls in that central floor area. Cozy saturated honey, cream, dark teal, warm chestnut outlines and fresh green accents. No realistic textures or soft gradients or blur. No visible animals, human objects at human scale, lettering, collage grid or frames. Single coherent game background. Match reference2 color warmth, reference1 intimacy.
prompts.icons: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite icon atlas for original cute GBA hamster raising game; reference image layout's panel2 action icons defines the warm bright pixel aesthetic. EXACTLY 8 clear separated square icons in a 4-column 2-row grid, evenly centered, generous transparent padding, uniform icon size, no text/no letters/no labels/no tile background/no frames/no shadows outside objects. Order row1: red running shoe with small wing (speed), wooden hamster exercise wheel (stamina), plump black-white striped sunflower seed being nibbled with a tiny bite notch (appetite), open blue book with short yellow pencil (intelligence). Order row2: green hedge miniature maze with red goal flag (dexterity), pink gingham pillow and small folded blanket (rest), green picnic satchel and flower (outing), rolled parchment map with small brass binoculars (course scouting). Bold readable silhouettes at 32-48 game pixels, warm dark brown pixel outlines, limited palette with red/coral,leafgreen,honeyyellow,skyblue. Crisp true retro pixel clusters, NO painterly soft gradients, NO emojis, no hamsters or characters. Actual transparent alpha. Cute polished handheld game inventory sprites.
